svg.aria-label: SPI command set and register map
svg.text: SPI command set and register map
Mode 0, MSB first. Opcode bit 7 selects direction: 0 means the host writes, 1 means the chip answers. Addresses are big endian on the wire, INT32 values are little endian.
byte address auto-increments; the frame is as long as chip select stays low
a frame that ends before the value sets the frame error flag
MISO returns 0x00, then payload byte 0, byte 1, ...: one byte of latency
Any other opcode sets the sticky command error bit and the rest of the frame is ignored.
cmd err and frame err are sticky; clear them with TRIG_CLR_STICKY
run, verify and clr C are refused while the chip is busy and set cmd err
each field little endian; counters saturate rather than wrap
a host reads this first and sizes its transfers from it, so host tooling survives a geometry change
Generated by tools/svg_memory_map.py from the same constants the protocol tests assert against the chip
